messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തിൽ ഞാൻ ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി, കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | **Nel** | preposition + definite article “in the” | *(omitted – expressed by case suffix)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **mezzo** | noun “midway, middle” | **മധ്യത്തിൽ** | “in the middle” | OK | | **del** | genitive marker “of the” | *(omitted – expressed by “‑യുടെ” suffix)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **cammin** | noun “road, journey” | **വഴി** | “road” | OK | | **di** | preposition “of” (genitive) | *(omitted – expressed by “‑യുടെ” suffix)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” | **നമ്മുടെ** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” | **ജീവിതം** | “life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun “myself” (part of the verb) | *(reflexivity rendered by “താനെ” later)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **ritrovai** | verb “found (myself)” | **കണ്ടെത്തി** | “found” | OK | | **per** | preposition “through, within” | *(omitted – expressed by locative case “‑യിൽ”)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **una** | indefinite article “a” | **ഒരു** | “a” | OK | | **selva** | noun “forest, wood” | **കാട്** | “forest” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” | **ഇരുണ്ട** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | conjunction “for, because” | **കാരണം** | “because/for” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” | *(omitted – not needed in Malayalam)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **diritta** | adjective “right, straight” | **ശരിയായ** | “right/correct” | OK | | **via** | noun “way, path” | **വഴി** | “way” | OK | | **era** | verb “was” (imperfect) | *(embedded in “നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു”)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **smarrita** | past participle “missed, lost” | **നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു** | “had been lost” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY** (omitted because Malayalam does not use separate words for these grammatical particles): *Nel, del, di, mi, per, la, era*
No source words are **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or exhibit **GRAMMAR** errors in the Malayalam rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: **നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തിൽ** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 2: - Original: **ഞാൻ ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി,** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 3: - Original: **കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു.** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തിൽ ഞാൻ ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിൽ താനെ കണ്ടെത്തി, കാരണം ശരിയായ വഴി നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു. ```
